SQL:
WITH _base AS (
  SELECT
    customers__regions.name AS "orders.customers.regions.name",
    customers.city AS "orders.customers.city",
    CAST(SUM(orders.amount) AS DOUBLE) AS "orders.revenue"
  FROM orders AS orders
  LEFT JOIN customers AS customers
    ON orders.customer_id = customers.id
  LEFT JOIN regions AS customers__regions
    ON customers.region_id = customers__regions.id
  GROUP BY
    customers__regions.name,
    customers.city
), _cm_orders__amount_sum_partition_by_customers_regions_name AS (
  SELECT
    customers__regions.name AS "orders.customers.regions.name",
    CAST(SUM(orders.amount) AS DOUBLE) AS "orders.amount_sum_partition_by_customers_regions_name"
  FROM orders AS orders
  LEFT JOIN customers AS customers
    ON orders.customer_id = customers.id
  LEFT JOIN regions AS customers__regions
    ON customers.region_id = customers__regions.id
  GROUP BY
    customers__regions.name
), _cm_orders__amount_sum_partition_by AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(SUM(orders.amount) AS DOUBLE) AS "orders.amount_sum_partition_by"
  FROM orders AS orders
)
SELECT
  _base."orders.customers.regions.name",
  _base."orders.customers.city",
  _base."orders.revenue",
  _base."orders.revenue" / _cm_orders__amount_sum_partition_by_customers_regions_name."orders.amount_sum_partition_by_customers_regions_name" AS "orders.share_of_region",
  _base."orders.revenue" / _cm_orders__amount_sum_partition_by."orders.amount_sum_partition_by" AS "orders.share_of_total"
FROM _base
LEFT JOIN _cm_orders__amount_sum_partition_by_customers_regions_name
  ON _base."orders.customers.regions.name" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_orders__amount_sum_partition_by_customers_regions_name."orders.customers.regions.name"
CROSS JOIN _cm_orders__amount_sum_partition_by
LIMIT 21

args.message: The table has 12 region/city groups. Revenue is the sum of order amounts. Each order is matched to its customer, and the customer to its region. Orders where the region or city is unknown are kept as their own groups, shown as blank (null) values. The share-of-region column divides each city's revenue by its region's total, so the cities in each region add up to 1. The share-of-total column divides by all revenue. Oslo shows up under both North and South, so it is listed separately in each region.
